lead: I'm Hassan, a student at Sheikh Isa Bin Ali's Secondary School. I'm into cyber security, Linux and Python, and I learn by making open source projects.

fields.label: Where I'm studying
fields.text: I'm a student at Sheikh Isa Bin Ali's Secondary School.

fields.label: What I'm learning
fields.text: I'm learning Python, and the way I'm doing it is by making open source projects. I'm also learning Russian and German, and I already speak Arabic and English.

fields.label: Where I'm headed
fields.text: I'm probably heading to university, and I'm hoping to get there with a scholarship. I'm also looking for an internship.

fields.label: What's different about me
fields.text: I don't make the same mistake three times.
